availableMixes.name: 3500 AIR ENTRAINED (AE)
availableMixes.desc: Often used for driveways, slabs, and moderate-load footings.

availableMixes.name: 4000 AIR ENTRAINED (AE)
availableMixes.desc: STANDARD. Used for sign foundations, commercial flatwork, and structural footings requiring good durability.

availableMixes.name: 4500 AIR ENTRAINED (AE)
availableMixes.desc: Used for heavy-duty commercial slabs and heavy traffic areas.

availableMixes.name: 5000 AIR ENTRAINED (AE)
availableMixes.desc: High-strength mix for heavy structural columns, pillars, and extreme load conditions.

availableMixes.name: FAST SET
availableMixes.desc: Quick-curing concrete used when rapid strength gain is needed to minimize downtime.

availableAdmixes.name: Calcium Chloride
availableAdmixes.desc: Speeds up how fast the concrete dries. SELECT THIS when pouring in cold weather so it doesn't freeze before it sets. WARNING: Do NOT select this if using Rebar, as it causes rust!

availableAdmixes.name: Set-Retarding Admix (Type D)
availableAdmixes.desc: Slows down how fast the concrete dries. SELECT THIS when pouring in very hot weather, or if the concrete truck has a very long drive to the site.

availableAdmixes.name: Water-Reducing Admix (Type A)
availableAdmixes.desc: Makes the concrete easier to pour without weakening it. SELECT THIS if you need the concrete to flow better into tight forms or around lots of rebar.

availableAdmixes.name: Fibers
availableAdmixes.desc: Tiny fibers mixed into the concrete to prevent small cracks. SELECT THIS for large flat slabs (like monument sign pads) or if the foundation will take physical abuse.

availableAdmixes.name: Winter Service
availableAdmixes.desc: A fee the plant charges to use hot water so the mix doesn't freeze. SELECT THIS always during winter months when temperatures are freezing.
